seating.notes: Aino-Kaarina sits directly next to Pavicky so she can hear the interpretation. Pavicky uses a lapel or handheld mic. Optional induction loop or receiver for Aino-Kaarina, with a sound check before the ceremony.

venue_notes: DATE BLOCKER: the brief's date (Sat 12 Sept 2026) is already past as of today (2026-10-13). The date field is the brief's value and is unconfirmed. Do not commit to or confirm any booking until the client confirms the real date.

Budget: hard cap EUR 42,000 all in. Request all-in quotes (VAT, service, travel, extras) from every vendor. total_eur is 0 because no quotes have been received yet. If tight, cut fireworks before the interpreter (the interpreter is the last item to cut). Pavicky needs a mic.

Quinta outreach: tell them Pimienta the dog is the ring bearer. Confirm chapel PA and mic for Pavicky. Confirm the wine cellar as the cocktail backup if the forecast is above 32 C. Ask about the fireworks permit. Pass on the nut allergy (EpiPen carrier, a child).

Caterer and cake maker outreach: strictly no nuts, including almonds, and ask about cross-contamination and a nut-free kitchen. 11 vegetarian meals and 4 children's meals. Ask for all-in quotes. Open question: whether the children and vegetarians overlap within the 96 guests (81 standard meals if not).
Shuttle outreach: two or more coaches, staggered returns with the last departure at 01:30, step-free boarding. Hotel details are still needed.
Photographer outreach: Lumière Fotografia must not be booked despite being the agency default, as the client explicitly excluded them. Request all-in quotes from alternatives.
DJ outreach: the banned song is Macarena, with no exceptions even if requested by the DJ or guests. Request a written confirmation.
Printer outreach: menu cards in Spanish and English. Finnish is added only if more than 25 of Eero's family confirm. Hold the Finnish decision until the count is confirmed.
Timing rule: if the ceremony starts late, shorten the cocktails and never the ceremony.

Open questions for the client: actual event date; confirmed count of Eero's family; hotel details; whether the children and vegetarians overlap; who makes the heat call (over 32 C) and when; status of any existing bookings; the photographer choice; the final menu.
